propositions: An unchanged related-ticket pin generated under a supported historical fingerprint algorithm is incorrectly classified as stale-pin-drift when the latest fingerprint differs due to algorithm evolution alone.

pin_health.derive_health compares pins only against the latest fingerprint and lacks the historical full-hash compatibility predicate that attest._legacy_material_ok already applies to the reviewed ticket's own material.

A related pin should be classified current when recomputed current material under a supported historical fingerprint generation exactly matches the signed pin, and remain stale only when all supported generations and latest fail to match.
The attestation wrapper must supply a narrowly-scoped compatibility predicate to pin_health.derive_health to discriminate genuine material drift from fingerprint-algorithm evolution.
